styleBible.visualWorld: 民國年間江南渡口的真人電影美術，環境潮濕克制，人物造型樸素並保留生活磨損。
styleBible.realityLevel: Photorealistic cinematic live-action with documentary restraint and no illustration styling.

capture.cameraSystem: Full-frame digital cinema camera with gentle highlight roll-off.
capture.lensLanguage: Natural perspective lenses for reference images and restrained cinematic depth for narrative frames.
capture.texture: Natural skin texture, visible pores, fine hair, honest fabric weave, and physically plausible wear.
capture.lighting: Motivated soft daylight, neutral skin exposure, controlled contrast, and no glamour lighting.
capture.colorScience: Muted navy, weathered brown, soft cream, cool grey mist, and restrained saturation.

styleBible.globalNegativePrompt: illustration, anime, cartoon, 3d render, game character, plastic skin, beauty retouching, identity drift, face morphing, celebrity likeness, modern styling, text, watermark

characters.name: 沈知微

identityLock.agePresentation: 外觀約十九歲，年輕但不帶幼童感。
identityLock.ancestryAndRegion: 東亞漢族外觀，符合民國江南水鄉生活背景。
identityLock.faceGeometry: 窄鵝蛋臉，臉頰柔和，下頜纖細，下巴短而圓。
identityLock.eyes: 深褐眼睛，眼距自然，眼神警覺且常帶遲疑。
identityLock.brows: 自然平緩眉形，眉色接近黑髮，眉眼距離固定。
identityLock.nose: 鼻樑纖細平直，鼻尖小而自然，側面輪廓固定。
identityLock.mouth: 唇形自然偏薄，唇峰柔和，嘴角慣常微收。
identityLock.skin: 自然偏白膚色，保留毛孔、淡淡血色與細小肌膚起伏。
identityLock.hair: 中央分線，兩條長黑辮，辮梢繫褪色紅繩，髮際固定。
identityLock.body: 身形單薄，肩膀微內收，四肢纖細，站姿帶輕微防備。
distinctiveMarks: 兩條長辮末端的褪色紅繩與緊抱皮箱時發白的指節。

performance.gaze: 多數時間避開長久對視，必要時短暫抬眼。
performance.posture: 肩膀微內收，手臂常護住胸前皮箱。
performance.movement: 動作幅度小，停頓略多，緊張時手指用力。

wardrobe.primary: 藏青色學生上衣、素白衣領與及小腿裙，搭配磨舊棕色皮箱。
wardrobe.continuityNotes: 所有圖片維持相同衣領寬度、鈕扣數量、裙長、辮繩位置、皮箱刮痕與磨損方向。

characters.basePrompt: A fictional nineteen-year-old Chinese student from the 1930s, slender build with slightly inward shoulders, narrow oval face, deep brown wary eyes, fine straight nose, naturally thin lips, pale natural skin with visible pores, centre-parted black hair in two long braids tied with faded red cord, wearing a worn navy student tunic with a plain cream collar and carrying a battered brown leather suitcase.
characters.basePromptZh: 虛構的十九歲民國女學生，身形單薄、肩膀微內收，窄鵝蛋臉、深褐警覺眼睛、纖細平直鼻形、自然偏薄嘴唇，偏白肌膚保留毛孔；中央分線黑髮編成兩條長辮，辮梢繫褪色紅繩，穿磨舊藏青學生裝配米白衣領，攜帶棕色舊皮箱。
characters.characterNegativePrompt: mature glamorous face, heavy makeup, modern haircut, loose hair, different braid length, different eye spacing, wide jaw, altered nose profile, glossy skin, luxury costume, modern suitcase, identity drift

shots.title: 角色身份固定參考圖表
shots.resolutionHint: At least 3072 pixels on the long edge
shots.camera: Full-frame cinema camera with a natural perspective lens
shots.lighting: Soft motivated daylight with neutral skin exposure
shots.prompt: Create a live-action identity lock board with front portrait, profile, three-quarter portrait, full body, hairline detail, skin detail, and wardrobe detail. Every panel must depict the exact same fictional person.
shots.promptZh: 建立專業真人身份固定板，包含正面肖像、側面、四分之三肖像、全身、髮際、肌膚與服裝細節；所有面板必須是完全相同的虛構人物。
shots.negativePrompt: different person, identity drift, face morphing, illustration, anime, 3d render, plastic skin, beauty retouching, modern clothing, extra fingers, text, watermark
acceptance: 所有畫面可辨識為同一位人物。
臉部骨相、髮型與膚色沒有漂移。
服裝、配件與身形比例保持連戲。
